modules.title: Scanning arrays

lessons.title: One pass is usually enough
Two pointers on sorted input
lessons.body_md:
When the input is sorted, a pointer at each end tells you which way to move: a sum that is too small can only grow by advancing the left pointer.

$$
i < j,\quad s = a_i + a_j
$$

:::callout{kind=pitfall}
Stop when the pointers meet: an element cannot pair with itself.
:::

:::question{slug=pair-sum-sorted}

checkpoint.prompt_md: On average, looking up a key in a hash map takes:
checkpoint.explanation_md: Hashing jumps straight to the bucket; only collisions cost extra.

checkpoint.prompt_md: Name the technique that walks a sorted array from both ends.
checkpoint.explanation_md: Two pointers: each step discards one end that cannot be part of the answer.
